lines.quote: Designed adaptive beamforming algorithms for Sumuvire's multi-element antenna products, including a 32-element L-band array for ground-based communication links.

Wrote a C++ implementation of a frequency-domain channel estimator for OFDM-based wideband links, running on an STM32H7 microcontroller. The module performs FFT-based channel estimation and subcarrier interpolation within a 2 ms frame deadline.

Developed and maintain a production Python pipeline for automated regression testing of antenna firmware: the pipeline pulls test vectors from the CI system, runs hardware-in-the-loop tests through a GPIB-connected signal generator, and generates pass/fail reports.

Work included network-analyser calibration of the receive chain (Keysight E5071C ENA), antenna radiation pattern measurements on the university's rooftop test range, and noise figure characterisation of the low-noise amplifier.
Implemented an extended Kalman filter for carrier frequency and Doppler tracking in Sumuvire's mobile terminal product line, handling fast-changing channel conditions in moving-vehicle scenarios.

requirements.name: Satellite or airborne platform experience
requirements.note: The CubeSat ground station work describes a ground-based receiving station that tracked a satellite; the text does not describe an instrument or system that itself flew on a satellite or aircraft.

lines.quote: I have some team-lead experience, which I would prefer to discuss in person rather than overstate in a letter.
Co-authored "Adaptive Beamforming Under Mutual Coupling: A Calibration-Aware Approach," presented at the Baltic Signal Processing Conference.
Finnish citizen, full EU work authorisation.
All specification documents, code reviews, and technical discussions at Sumuvire Wireless are conducted in English.
I am already in Oulu — I moved here when I joined Sumuvire in 2019 — so working onsite at Kaikuvaara is not an issue.
